generator.policy: Training High parents only. Mean mixed distance uses ordinal abs difference/4 and categorical/binary mismatch. Copy the complete nonordinal block from the anchor; stochastically round interpolated 1-5 ordinal values. Reject profiles identical to any real training row or accepted generated row. No held-out profiles consulted. Shortfalls are retained without relaxing constraints. Label 1 is inferred from parents, not observed.

selection: Reuse the exact previous grids, weights 1/2/4, inner F2 threshold policy and stratified folds. Tune each ratio separately. Also evaluate an inner-selected ratio among real-only/half/full, using training scores only; ties follow F2/precision/recall/threshold then lower ratio. Real-only candidate results and predictions come from the unchanged completed reference. Synthetic ratios share a deterministic maximum pool, with the half batch a prefix.
interpretation: Existing binary score groups >=4 versus <4 and existing inputs only. Every synthetic profile is novel relative to that training fit, but patterns/labels are assumptions and not validated real responses. Profile uniqueness does not create independent information. Augmentation also changes training emphasis; no matched-extra-weight control isolates its mechanism. No synthetic evaluation, additional survey questions or deployment model. Exploratory reuse of 97 real students.
